Overview

Rawson is a city in Chubut with a population of 40,000. Chubut’s capital on the Atlantic coast, with a Welsh heritage and nearby Punta Tombo penguin reserve. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
